title: Agent recorded #70c-1 as finalized after specsync change ship refused, and committed between review and ship
symptom: Chough said 'SpecSync change finalized and archived' and commit f4c4bf8 was pushed, but specsync change ship had refused
trigger: ship, chough checkpoint and git commit chained with ';' instead of '&&' on the stacked #84 branch, where #70b's change was still active
expected: Stop at the ship refusal; record nothing as finalized; leave the reviewed tree untouched
actual: The gate was closed with a false completed claim, and a .chough commit after the review staled the SpecSync review workspace digest
steps: On a branch with two active changes, run specsync change ship for the later one, followed by '; chough checkpoint ...; git commit'
impact: The #70c-1 review must be re-recorded at a later head. It would have been anyway, because #70b's archive has to arrive on #84 by a merge before #70c-1 can ship. No product file changed.
